# Third-party software: verify-refs

Source: [Aperivue/medsci-skills, verify-refs](https://github.com/Aperivue/medsci-skills/tree/e0ea3b0be3bf529aa0b94ee5fd8450e78848932c/skills/verify-refs). Suite v6.3.0, commit `e0ea3b0be3bf529aa0b94ee5fd8450e78848932c`, inspected 2026-11-18. See the [upstream script](https://github.com/Aperivue/medsci-skills/blob/e0ea3b0be3bf529aa0b94ee5fd8450e78848932c/skills/verify-refs/scripts/verify_refs.py) and [upstream license](https://github.com/Aperivue/medsci-skills/blob/e0ea3b0be3bf529aa0b94ee5fd8450e78848932c/LICENSE).

The bundled [article verifier](../scripts/verify_references.py) incorporates adapted upstream routines. This integration tightens article identity checks, adds source-specific routing and reports unresolved evidence without modifying bibliography files. The upstream project and its maintainers are not responsible for these modifications.
